## Hinge question · Select the right total {#l2-hinge .compact}

| Pets, $x$ | 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 |
|:---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Frequency | 15 | 20 | 10 | 4 | 1 |
```{=html}
<div data-module="hinge" data-correct="3" class="hinge numeric-choices">
<p class="hinge-question">A household is selected from these 50. What is the estimated probability that it owns at most 2 pets?</p>
<div class="hinge-toolbar"><div class="time" role="timer" aria-label="Time remaining">1:00</div><div class="toolbar"><label>Seconds <select class="timer-duration" aria-label="Question duration"><option>30</option><option>45</option><option selected>60</option><option>90</option><option>120</option></select></label><button class="timer-start primary">Start</button><button class="reset-question">Reset</button></div></div><div class="choices"><button class="choice" data-answer="1" aria-pressed="false"><b>1</b><span>0.20</span></button><button class="choice" data-answer="2" aria-pressed="false"><b>2</b><span>0.70</span></button><button class="choice" data-answer="3" aria-pressed="false"><b>3</b><span>0.90</span></button><button class="choice" data-answer="4" aria-pressed="false"><b>4</b><span>0.10</span></button></div>
<div class="hinge-bottom"><p>Fist on chest. Think quietly. On “show”, hold up 1–4 fingers.</p><button class="reveal-answer primary">Reveal answer</button></div>
<div class="hinge-explanation" hidden>3. Include 0, 1 and 2 pets: (15 + 20 + 10)/50 = 0.90. Option 1 uses exactly 2; option 2 omits 2; option 4 uses the complementary event.</div>
</div>
```

::: notes
Allow 45–60 seconds with fists on chests. On “show”, collect simultaneous 1–4 finger responses before revealing.

Correct answer: 3. At most 2 includes 0, 1 and 2 pets, so the estimate is $(15+20+10)/50=0.90$.

- 1: counts exactly 2 pets only.
- 2: includes 0 and 1 but excludes 2.
- 4: counts the complementary event, more than 2 pets.

Ready: ask why choices 3 and 4 sum to 1, then proceed.
Divided: ask pairs to list the included pet counts before re-polling on “show”.
Further explanation needed: return to the event-highlighting slide, explicitly include the boundary value 2, then re-poll.
:::
